potions.description: Heal for #b20% of your Max HP.

potions.name: Elixir
potions.description: #yExhaust any number of cards in your hand.

potions.name: Attack Potion
potions.description: Choose #b1 of #b3 random #yAttack cards to add to your hand, it costs #b0 this turn.

potions.name: Skill Potion
potions.description: Choose #b1 of #b3 random #ySkill cards to add to your hand, it costs #b0 this turn.

potions.name: Power Potion
potions.description: Choose #b1 of #b3 random #yPower cards to add to your hand, it costs #b0 this turn.

potions.name: Colorless Potion
potions.description: Choose #b1 of #b3 random #yColorless cards to add to your hand, it costs #b0 this turn.

potions.name: Flex Potion
potions.description: Gain #b5 #yStrength. At the end of your turn, lose #b5 #yStrength.

potions.name: Speed Potion
potions.description: Gain #b5 #yDexterity. At the end of your turn, lose #b5 #yDexterity.

potions.name: Blessing of the Forge
potions.description: Upgrade all cards in your hand for the rest of combat.

potions.name: Gambler's Brew
potions.description: Discard any number of cards then draw that many.

potions.name: Duplication Potion
potions.description: This turn, your next card is played twice.

potions.name: Distilled Chaos
potions.description: Play the top #b3 cards of your draw pile.

potions.name: Liquid Memories
potions.description: Choose a card in your discard pile and return it to your hand. It costs #b0 this turn.

potions.name: Snecko Oil
potions.description: Draw #b5 cards. Randomize the cost of cards in your hand.

potions.name: Fairy in a Bottle
potions.description: When you would die, heal to #b30% of your Max HP instead and discard this potion.

potions.name: Smoke Bomb
potions.description: Escape from a non-boss combat. Receive no rewards.

potions.name: Entropic Brew
potions.description: Fill all your empty potion slots with random potions.
